slides.title: The chair of clothes is a cry for help. Closet finds that fixed mine.
Why the chair happens
slides.body: Worn-once clothes don't feel clean or dirty, so they have no home. The chair becomes the home.

slides.title: An over-door hook rack for 'worn once'
slides.body: Give those clothes an official spot. Hanging on a hook is as easy as tossing on a chair.

slides.title: Open bins instead of folding drawers
slides.body: Tops bin, pants bin, pajamas bin. Toss in, done. Folding is optional in this house.

slides.title: Slim non-slip hangers
slides.body: Clothes stay on, and you fit more. Fewer clothes sliding to the closet floor.

slides.title: A hamper right next to where you undress
slides.body: Not in the bathroom if you change in the bedroom. Put it where the clothes come off.

slides.title: The chair was never the problem. It was the only system that matched my brain.
